Former Coach Gillespie Criticizes Pakistan Selectors Amid England Struggles

Former Pakistan cricket coach Andy Flower has criticized the national team's selectors for changing their minds frequently, likening it to changing pants. This statement comes amid Pakistan's ongoing struggles in their series against England. The selectors reportedly made a mid-series overhaul of the team.
